title: [P2][Audit A12, A22] Validate decision responses and enforce whole-call SDK deadlines
body: Implement the remaining A12 portion of public issue 9424 in `crates/jev`. Validate finite numeric ranges, probability mass within a documented tolerance, selected option identities, and score legend bounds before returning typed decisions. At the typed request-aware boundary, validate required answer coverage, answer types, and option identities. Invalid answers must return structured validation errors; preserve a separate raw compatibility path. Cover Noul, Choice, and Score malformed responses and valid compatibility cases through async and blocking clients with bounded local mocks. Read `.agents/skills/typesafe-ai/SKILL.md` and the pinned `docs/decision-models/2026-09-20-score-contract.md`; preserve that selected-answer and calibrated-score contract when interpreting confidence and probabilities. This task does not choose model thresholds or call a provider. A22 whole-call deadlines are already implemented at this source and are outside this task. Work only within `crates/jev/`; run ordinary tests with `--features jev/blocking` and formatting checks. Do not enable the live feature. Broader consumer regression checks and deployment are outside this isolated SDK trial.
